subject: One slim sage green pocket paperback with gently fanned cream pages and a simple leaf emblem on the cover, no writing
prompt:
Generate ONE new individual sticker in the exact illustrative style of the supplied original desktop sticker references. References are style only, not subjects to copy.
Art direction: hand-painted 2D casual-game illustration with restrained local contrast, warm mid-light colors, thin warm locally colored outlines, simple matte painted volumes, just two or three quiet same-hue shadow patches. Modest detail and small broad paint marks. Soft illustrative volume matching the reference artwork. No shiny 3D toy appearance, deep dark crevices, harsh light, or dense surface texture. Do not anthropomorphize objects.
Entire subject centered and fully visible with clear padding on all sides; a narrow clean white sticker-cut margin follows the silhouette. No scene, floor shadow, text, letters, brand or watermark.
Deliver a PNG with a TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: empty canvas outside the sticker, actual alpha transparency.
Square canvas, target 512 x 512. Entire sticker visible with clear padding.
SUBJECT: One slim sage green pocket paperback with gently fanned cream pages and a simple leaf emblem on the cover, no writing. Draw only the named book or connected set of books, not the readers or other objects in the references. Keep covers and page edges plainly constructed, with a clean readable silhouette and restrained hand-painted detail. No readable text, labels, logos or decorative clutter. The complete sticker including its narrow white cut margin occupies about 80 percent of the canvas in its longest dimension, with transparent padding on every side.
note: The saved master is the selected second pass. The initial exact prompt and references above produced the archived v1. The second pass used the exact selected_edit prompt below and the v1 image as its only image input.

selected_edit.prompt: Edit the most recent generated green book sticker only. Make it clearly a SLIM pocket paperback, about one third of its current thickness: a flexible thin sage cover with a shallow cream page block and just a few lightly fanned pages at the top. Keep the simple leaf emblem, warm hand-painted 2D style, full silhouette, narrow white cut margin, generous padding and real transparent PNG background. No text, letters, scene or extra objects.
